support_claim: CRM NBA-102 and billing's Northbridge Analytics Inc. are name-compatible but the packet preserves unresolved registry identity and supplies no establishing link between the two referents.

steps.fact: The left referent crm:NBA-102 corresponds to CRM row NBA-102 with account name "Northbridge Analytics".
The right referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. corresponds to invoices with billed_name "Northbridge Analytics Inc.".

Commercial notes state that sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics" while billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc.", but also report a separate Wyoming LLC "Northbridge Analytics LLC" from a 2024 credit check.
Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs to treat the registry link as unresolved.
The packet provides no shared legal identifier, explicit mapping, or other establishing evidence linking NBA-102 to the billing entity Northbridge Analytics Inc.
Name similarity between "Northbridge Analytics" (CRM) and "Northbridge Analytics Inc." (billing) is insufficient to establish identity under the grounding contract.
